payload.sbml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<sbml xmlns="http://www.sbml.org/sbml/level3/version2/core" level="3" version="2">
  <model id="synthetic_ode_model" name="synthetic_ode_model" timeUnits="second">
    <listOfCompartments>
      <compartment id="default" spatialDimensions="0" size="1" units="dimensionless" constant="true"/>
    </listOfCompartments>
    <listOfParameters>
      <parameter id="k" value="2" units="dimensionless" constant="true"/>
      <parameter id="d" value="1" units="dimensionless" constant="true"/>
      <parameter id="x" value="0" units="dimensionless" constant="false"/>
    </listOfParameters>
    <listOfRules>
      <rateRule variable="x">
        <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML">
          <apply>
            <minus/>
            <ci> k </ci>
            <apply>
              <times/>
              <ci> d </ci>
              <ci> x </ci>
            </apply>
          </apply>
        </math>
      </rateRule>
    </listOfRules>
  </model>
</sbml>
